department: Graduate College — Interdisciplinary Graduate Programme (IGP) Neuroscience Ph.D. Programme

deadline.value: IGP August semester deadline is January 31, 2027 (January semester: July 31).

gre_subject.value: IGP requires GRE General (V >= 153, Q >= 149, V+Q >= 319, AW >= 3.5; or GATE >= 97% for India) for overseas degree holders and does not require the GRE Psychology Subject Test.
gre_subject.quote: GRE | (With validity of 5 years from date of application) | Minimum Verbal Reasoning Measure (V) ≥ 153 | Minimum Quantitative Reasoning Measure (Q) ≥ 149 | Minimum Analytical Writing (AW) ≥ 3.5 | Total V+Q ≥ 319

supervisor.value: Incoming Neuroscience PhD students can complete up to 3 optional ~2-month lab rotations in year 1 to select a mentor (initial guidance provided by the Programme Director if no mentor is chosen beforehand).
supervisor.quote: Neuroscience Ph.D. students are encouraged to complete up to 3 laboratory rotations. The goals of these rotations are to provide exposure to different conceptual approaches and experimental techniques, as well as to expose students to several laboratories to help them identify their Ph.D. mentor and home laboratory.

also.quote: The Director of the Neuroscience Ph.D. Programme will provide initial guidance to students prior to selection of a faculty mentor and Thesis Advisory Committee.

funding.value: Full-time Neuroscience PhD students are eligible for full tuition and living-stipend financial support (RSS S$3,000/mo, PGA/NPGS S$4,300/mo international) for up to 4 years.
funding.quote: All students are eligible for full financial support, including payment of their tuition and a stipend to cover their living expenses.

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a relevant bachelor's degree with 1st Class Honours or equivalent (India: 1st Class Honours with Distinction; China: 85%+ average).
entry_route.quote: For Applicants with Overseas Degree | Relevant Bachelor Degree with 1st Class Honours or equivalent | Relevant Bachelor Degree with 1st Class Honours (with Distinction)

gre_general.value: Required for overseas degree applicants: GRE V >= 153, Q >= 149, V+Q >= 319, AW >= 3.5 (within 5 years); Indian applicants may substitute GATE >= 97% (within 3 years).
gre_general.quote: For Applicants with Overseas Degree | AND | GRE | Minimum Verbal Reasoning Measure (V) ≥ 153 | Minimum Quantitative Reasoning Measure (Q) ≥ 149 | Minimum Analytical Writing (AW) ≥ 3.5 | Total V+Q ≥ 319 | India - Can replace with GATE score | ≥ 97%

toefl_min.value: IGP requires TOEFL iBT >= 105 (or IELTS >= 7.0) within 2 years unless waived via 3+ years of English-medium tertiary study.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL | (With validity of 2 years from date of application) | Internet Based Test ≥ 105

ielts_min.value: IGP requires IELTS >= 7.0 (or TOEFL iBT >= 105) within 2 years unless waived via 3+ years of English-medium tertiary study.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS | (With validity of 2 years from date of application) | Minimum Score ≥ 7.0

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS may be waived if the applicant's tertiary studies (minimum 3 years) were conducted in English and a certification letter from the institution is provided at application.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL/IELTS Requirement may be waived if medium of instruction for applicant’s tertiary studies (minimum 3 years) was conducted in English | Certification letter for medium of instruction from applicant’s tertiary institution must be provided during application

notes: NTU's Interdisciplinary Graduate Programme (IGP) Neuroscience Ph.D. brings together >80 faculty across 10 schools (including LKCMedicine, SBS, CCDS, MAE, EEE, CCEB, MSE, SSS). Note LKCMedicine also admits direct-entry PhD students into its Neuroscience & Mental Health research programme.
